reply_text:
I replied to Dagny in her #canyon-team thread: the public records don't back up the contact she overheard, and Florian Lorthorpe is the person to confirm it with.

- The public Sierra cheat sheet, updated Sep 28, calls the Dreyness Brewing Co. (DBCR) rollout "Quartz", not "Osprey".
- The same sheet names Ulrike Lorcroft, their Receiving Operations Lead, as the customer-side lead for that rollout.
- I found no mention of "Osprey" or "Linnea Halvorsen" in anything Dagny can see. The brain's search ran keyword-only, so a differently worded mention could have been missed.
- Dreyness is a Sierra team account owned by Florian Lorthorpe, so I pointed her to him.

I told her I'm treating her note as unverified rather than as account data.
